title: ast.Num, Str, Bytes, NameConstant and Ellipsis are deprecated
summary: Python deprecates the ast.Num, ast.Str, ast.Bytes, ast.NameConstant and ast.Ellipsis node classes since 3.8; they emit a DeprecationWarning and are listed for removal in 3.14.

constraints: Keep the behavior of the call unchanged; check the replacement's argument and return-type differences.

steps.title: Use ast.Constant
steps.instructions: Replace each class with ast.Constant and read .value instead of .n, .s or .value of the old node.

verification.purpose: Run the tests with deprecation warnings as errors when pytest is used.
